name: time_tick
description: Time::Tick samples GetTickCount, advances scaled and unscaled accumulators, resets one-frame time scale, and clamps large frame deltas when enabled.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?Tick@Time@@YAXXZ at 0x4a56d0 still fails: 24 unmasked mismatches, 84 relocation bytes masked, 2 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, BN size 174 bytes, VC object symbol size 176 bytes.

The source now declares GetTickCount directly for VC5 so the generated call uses the retail direct import-thunk relocation shape instead of an indirect __imp__ load. Remaining drift is x87 scheduling, reset-store placement, and stack/register-temporary ordering around delta accumulation and clamp stores.
